summary: Petrobras filed a 6-K reminding non-resident investors of the procedure and December 7, 2026 deadline to request tax-exempt or differentiated treatment on the R$1.34814262 per common and preferred share dividend, part of the R$17.4 billion 2Q26 shareholder remuneration approved August 6, 2026. Requests must be submitted through B3's system and supporting documentation sent to book-entry agent Banco Bradesco. Petrobras reiterates all other terms remain unchanged. No special situation: this is an administrative notice. Watch only for potential investor tax-treatment denials, which carry no deal terms or arbitrage angle.
